name: Booking Interface — test ride modal opens, validates inputs, and submits successfully
description: Verifies that clicking 'BOOK A TEST RIDE' opens the booking dialog, handles validation, and transitions to the confirmation view upon submission.

planSteps.description: Navigate to / and scroll into the '#choose-your-ride' section
Click the 'BOOK A TEST RIDE' button
The test ride booking modal dialog opens with form fields for Full Name, Phone, Email, Dealership City, and Preferred Date
Click 'CONFIRM TEST RIDE' without filling the name input
HTML5 form validation prevents submission and requests completion of the required fields
Enter 'Jane Doe' in the full name field, '+91 9876543210' in phone, 'jane.doe@example.com' in email, and select city 'Bengaluru'
The booking submission succeeds and displays the confirmation screen with heading 'TEST RIDE CONFIRMED'
The confirmation summary card displays rider 'Jane Doe' and location 'Bengaluru'
The booking modal closes and returns to the Collection view
